jobs.title: Senior VLSI Design Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Senior VLSI Design Engineer Skip to content Careers ← All Jobs Senior VLSI Design Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate About The Position The Istra Hardware team is a top-tier group focused on developing and refining the hardware capabilities within Istra's complex product. Our implementation process is end-to-end, covering all hardware development components. In this role, you will take full end-to-end responsibility for the system, architecture, design, implementation, and testing of various complex FPGA-based hardware systems and accelerators. We are seeking an individual with strong analytical and design capabilities, as well as extensive hands-on experience in all aspects of hardware development. In this role, you will be a key player in: Design & Implementation: Creating complex FPGA-based systems for ultra-low latency applications. System Ownership: Driving the entire development lifecycle, from characterizing system requirements and specs to defining the SW-HW API. Problem Solving: Applying a systematic approach to analyze and debug complex production issues, pinpointing the root cause in either the hardware or software domain. Infrastructure Development: Building and implementing hardware analysis and development infrastructures to shorten the development cycles even further. Requirements What you’ll need to succeed: BSc/MSc in Computer/Electrical Engineering from a well known academic institute (Cum Laude). At least 5 years experience in hardware design. Former experience in hardware-integrated software development, with a comprehensive understanding of the full product stack and its interfaces. Proficient in HDL (Verilog / System Verilog / VHDL) language. Lab debugging and troubleshooting skills. Experience in FPGA development for Xilinx devices - advantage Software skills in C/C++ - advantage. Scripting skills in Python / R / Tcl - advantage. Self sufficient with a can-do attitude. Team player with excellent communication skills Apply for this position

jobs.title: Software Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Software Engineer Skip to content Careers ← All Jobs Software Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate About The Position Istra is a leading Algo-Trading research company specializing in developing and deploying High Frequency Trading strategies (HFT). We use state of the art technology and algorithms that are developed by our elite highly-skilled group of experienced researchers and developers in a challenging, pleasant, and rewarding work environment. We are constantly looking for experienced & skilled Software Engineers to join our team. In this role, you will: Design, develop, analyze and implement advanced cutting edge distributed automated trading systems - demanding extreme throughput and latency optimization. Take part in the full life cycle development of data engineering analytics, in a complex, research environment, while contributing directly to our dynamic, operational flows (CI/CD). Work with quants to build scalable infrastructures and develop algorithms for modeling the financial market. Build tools and simulators for exploring market opportunities and analyzing the competitive landscape. Study and exploit bit level considerations to optimize throughput and latency of cross hardware and software components. Manage and monitor an on-premise cluster and our cloud based environment, where we execute data demanding pipelines. Requirements What you’ll need to succeed: Cum laude BSc. in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering from a well-known academic institute. Strong knowledge and experience developing scalable systems, preferably in C++ Experience in design & development of large scale enterprise systems – advantage Experience in the areas of latency, high-throughput network programming – advantage Passion for big data and data-driven decision making A deep sense of intellectual curiosity and excellence Independent, thorough, motivated, and innovative So, if you love challenges, have a constant striving for excellence and a desire to be influential, we would love to hear from you. Apply for this position

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Database Reliability Engineer Skip to content Careers ← All Jobs Database Reliability Engineer Istra Research · Full-time · Intermediate About The Position Istra is a successful leading Algo-Trading research company specializing in developing and deploying High Frequency Trading strategies (HFT). We use state of the art technology and algorithms that are developed by our elite highly-skilled group of experienced researchers and developers in a challenging, pleasant, and rewarding work environment. We are seeking a knowledgeable, purpose-driven Database Reliability Engineer to join our infrastructure and operations team. In this role you will be: Design, implement, configure, and maintain database platforms, including MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, etc. within Linux environments. Manage databases deployed across both on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments. Support developers and users with query design, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying bottlenecks and recommending improvements. Maintain database availability, reliability, data integrity, security, backup, and recovery processes. Work closely with developers, researchers, and infrastructure teams to resolve operational issues and improve database services. Assist with the operation and optimization of large-scale, high-throughput database clusters and distributed data platforms. Contribute to the planning, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement of database operations and procedures. Requirements What you’ll need to succeed: 8+ years of experience in database engineering within large-scale, production-critical environments. Strong hands-on expertise in database infrastructure, automation, reliability, and performance optimization. Deep knowledge of database architecture, Linux systems, and system-level troubleshooting. Proven experience with MySQL, Redis, and InfluxDB. Working knowledge of ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch. Strong scripting or programming skills for infrastructure automation. Experience using AI agents or AI-assisted tools in complex technical environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a relevant technical certification, or equivalent practical experience. A practical and analytical approach to problem-solving, with strong communication skills and a high level of ownership. Advantage: Experience applying modern DevOps practices within complex environments. Apply for this position
